name: AllUnity USD
oneLiner: USDAU is AllUnity's dollar e-money token, backed by segregated USD reserves with par redemption subject to identity and compliance checks.
collateral: USD cash and eligible USD high-quality liquid assets held in separate accounts at EU-regulated credit institutions; the current cash/HQLA split and bank allocations are unverified.
pegMechanism: AllUnity issues and redeems USDAU at USD 1 under MiCA. Direct redemption requires identity, AML and sanctions checks and a bank account in the holder's name; no executable backstop is modeled.
launchPhaseDetail: AllUnity announced public availability on six chains on September 30, 2026. Positive issuance was verified on Tempo; Pharos has no admitted price or aggregate supply lane.

listingStatusReview.reason: Public issuance verified on Tempo; no admitted price lane or whole-asset supply lane. Six native deployments require an admitted aggregate supply source before active tracking.

milestones.title: AllUnity announces USDAU public launch
milestones.description: AllUnity announced USDAU availability through its Business Mint Account and ecosystem partners on Ethereum, Solana, Base, Tempo, Arc and Polygon.
